legend: Today is Rajaee's birthday!! Who$$$Who$$$ Asked?$$$Asked?$$$

Sadly, no one remembered his birthday, so he decided to make a birthday cake by himself. He went searching in the kitchen for suitable ingredients, but unfortunately, he found nothing but an array of positive integer numbers. He is going to make a cake out of this array using the following technique:
Firstly, he divides the array into several consecutive non-empty subarrays.
Every element of the array should belong to exactly one subarray.
Then for each subarray, he creates an edge of length equal to the sum of the numbers in the subarray.
Then he forms a cake in the shape of a convex polygon using all the edges he created.

Rajaee is wondering in how many ways he can divide the array into smaller subarrays such that he can make a cake out of it. Rajaee is too bad at maths so he needs your help to know the number of ways modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.
Two ways are considered different if there exists an element with index i$$$i$$$ belonging to two different subarrays in each way.
input: The first line contains a single integer number N$$$N$$$ (3≤N≤106)$$$(3 \le N \le 10^6)$$$, the size of the array.
The second line contains N$$$N$$$ integer numbers a1,a2,..,aN$$$a_1, a_2,.., a_N$$$ (1≤ai≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i \le 10^9)$$$, the elements of the array.
output: Output the number of ways modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.

legend.ai: 今天是 Rajaee 的生日！！谁$$$Who$$$问了？$$$Asked?$$$
遗憾的是，没有人记得他的生日，所以他决定亲手做一个生日蛋糕。他去厨房寻找合适的食材，但不幸的是，除了一个由正整数构成的数组外，他什么也没找到。他打算用下面的技巧用这个数组做一个蛋糕：
首先，他把数组分成若干个连续的非空子数组。
数组中的每个元素都应恰好属于一个子数组。
然后对于每个子数组，他创建一条边，其长度等于该子数组中所有数字之和。
接着，他用创建的所有边构成一个凸多边形形状的蛋糕。
Rajaee 想知道，他有多少种方法可以将数组划分成更小的子数组，使得他可以用这些子数组做出一个蛋糕。Rajaee 数学不太好，因此他需要你的帮助，求出方法数对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模后的结果。
如果存在一个下标为 i$$$i$$$ 的元素，在两种划分方式中分别属于不同的子数组，那么这两种方式就被视为不同。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$(3≤N≤106)$$$(3 \le N \le 10^6)$$$，表示数组的大小。

output.ai: 输出方法数对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模后的结果。
